description: Figure 5(b), titled “P6: Matching statistics,” is a pie chart summarizing how Persona 6’s matched questions are distributed across frequency tiers, showing 6 slices in total. The slices are labeled 1 through 6 and are colored in light pastel tones (including pale yellow, light blue, and light green), with percentage labels and counts printed inside each slice. The largest slice is tier 6 in light blue at approximately 27.2% (8006), followed by tier 2 at about 22.4% (6583); tier 1 is about 13.8% (4046), tier 0 is about 13.3% (3910), tier 4 is about 10.4% (3043), tier 5 is about 6.2% (1810), and tier 3 is about 6.8% (2007). There is no separate legend visible for the tiers, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
